text_block_list.text:
An aristocratic mansion near Tracen 
Academy. There, "a certain fan event" 
hosted by Umamusume was about to take 
place.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
A "Pushy Aristocrat Tournament", huh. 
Awawawa...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
The Umamusume who could skillfully play 
the noble coming on aggressively, quite 
literally, would win...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Now that I'm taking part, I've got to give 
it my all! I'll show them what I can do!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
But still... will I really be able to do 
well, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Now then, for the "Pushy Noble 
Tournament." I, Fuji Kiseki, shall play 
the role of the one being pursued.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"To all our fans, if you think they were 
proactive enough, please hit the like 
button! Now, first aristocrat, please go 
ahead♪"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Fuji-san, you belong to me now.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
If you would accept this forceful proposal 
of mine—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: You've accepted it... Then what?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Please leave the management to me. To 
ensure your clan runs smoothly, from 
solving issues to managing the estate...
(Bzzzt!)

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ah, too bad. The pushiness was good, but 
maybe the crowd thought you were being too 
kind. Next person, please!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Um... would I not do...? If there's 
anything I can do to help you, even a 
little...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, that's another shame... You had 
plenty of charm, but maybe you were paying 
too much attention to how they were 
reacting.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Executing—aggressive pull.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Whoops... instant disqualification~ Your 
idea was pretty exotic, though! Maybe it 
turned out a bit funny, but still.
And so, the turn order moved along—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: U-Um! I want to steal you away!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Even if I have to resort to brute 
force...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
(Whoa, are you sure about that? Saying 
something like that~?)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I won't... let go ever again!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: ...Or something like that, perhaps?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, so close...! If you're going to be 
that aggressive, you might as well push 
all the way through..."
(Ta-daaa!)

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Even so, you passed! Was that final line a 
cute little surprise? It seems it was very 
well-received!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Ahahaha... It's a complicated feeling...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"Huh, the 'Gung-Ho Aristocrat 
Tournament'... I didn't know you 
participated in something that sounded so 
fun."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, dressed like this. But just like in 
my races, that occasional lack of a 
finishing touch showed up again.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
It's frustrating... Hey, Palmer. Do you 
mind if I go against you one more time?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah! Then try to close in on me! 
Trainer, how should Ryan close in at the 
end to make it look cool?

I think to myself. An aggressive, pushy 
stance that would suit Mejiro Ryan would 
be...
choice_data_list: I'll protect you with all my might.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"Protecting through sheer toughness, huh? 
That sounds right! Pushing forward with 
the pure appeal of power!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Come and get it, you villains! I won't let 
you lay a single finger on my Palmer!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Hah! Take that! Teyaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Huh... Ryan... That kinda touches my 
heart...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa, now you're completely captivated 
by me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Let's muscle-up!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
...No, wait, did you really need to add 
that last part?

Though the conclusion was typical for her, 
Mejiro Ryan had fully demonstrated her 
impressive strength.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Sincerity, huh? Going straight ahead with 
that kind of approach sounds nice too. In 
that case...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Palmer. My feelings for you cannot be 
stopped! No matter how many times you 
reject me, I will never back down!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ryan... You're even sharper than usual 
today...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: So... that's why...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Pleeaaase!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Huh... No... if you put it that way, 
rather than pushy, isn't that just being a 
nice person...?

"Though her casual side slipped through at 
the very end, Mejiro Ryan poured every 
ounce of her sincerity into those words."
